limitations: Native Settings shows DaBin 0.0.0 (0) because Bundle.main is the fixture executable. Video should crop the actual Automatic capture section below that version panel; do not redraw version text.
Archive backup native menu was not opened: system tracking may move an offscreen menu onto the live desktop. Use the actual board More control and an editorial route cue.
Clipboard History contains fixture captures, not a real clipboard capture history. No clipboard is read or written.
Reminders in the fixture are draft/persisted data; no OS notification is scheduled.
Focus alarm PNG is a hypothetical timer-end example, not evidence that 25 minutes elapsed during capture; a focus session does not complete the task.
These PNGs document safe native states. Transitions in the marketing video are editorial animation, not recorded interaction footage.
